The '''fifth''' of nine [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Color/Legends|reddish-orange]] [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Dwi'kar]] was located in the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]]. [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] maintained an [[Botha Ammunitions Corporation orbiting station|orbiting station]] around the moon to refine [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gases]] harvested from Dwi'kar and its gas giant counterpart, [[Dwi'lar]].<ref name="SOTE">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>
